Open the ACE66 Sign-In Page

  1. Use Log In. It opens the account page in a new tab.
  2. Use the sign-in control on that page.
  3. If you need a new account instead, read the Registration Guide.

If the ACE66 Page Does Not Open

  • Check that the new tab is the account page, not this guide.
  • Reload the tab. A failed load is a connection problem, not a password problem.
  • Password help, if ACE66 offers it, is on that sign-in screen. It is not collected here.

Payment questions after you are signed in belong on the payment checks. Account questions are on the FAQ.

FAQ

I forgot my password. How do I reset it?

On the sign-in screen, use Forgot Password and complete the reset form. The new password is sent by SMS to the mobile number registered on the account. If the SMS does not arrive, contact ACE66 live chat.

I forgot my username. How do I recover it?

Contact ACE66 live chat and give the mobile number used to register the account.

Before You Sign Up for ACE66

  • You need to be 18 or older, and registration must be legal for you.
  • A promotion is optional. Read ACE66 promotions before you claim one. Percentages and turnover stay on the live card.
  • Set a play limit before the first deposit.

Open the ACE66 Registration Page

  1. Use Sign Up. It opens the account page in a new tab.
  2. Use the registration control on that page and follow the fields it shows.
  3. If you already have an account, read the Login Guide instead.

This site does not list identity documents, bonus codes or approval times, because those steps are shown by ACE66 during registration.

FAQ

How do I sign up?

Sign Up external opens the registration form. Submit it with the details the form asks for.

Can I register more than one ACE66 account?

No. Each member can have one active ACE66 account.

My details were already used by someone else. What should I do?

Contact ACE66 live chat. This page cannot complete the registration for you.

1. Home

FAQ

ACE66 FAQ Malaysia — Accounts, Payments, Bonuses & More

ACE66 Accounts, Payments and Promotions

How do I open ACE66?

Use Sign Up to create an account, or Log In to open an existing one. Sign-in and registration steps are on the Login Guide and the Registration Guide.

Can I register on this page?

No. This page does not take an account form. Sign Up external opens registration. The steps are on the Registration Guide.

How do I check whether I qualify for a promotion?

Open the promotion card and read who it is for, the end date, the games, the turnover and the claim step. The ACE66 promotions page lists those checks. The amount and the percentage stay on the live card.

Where do I see my VIP level?

Log In external, then open the VIP page. A level change is sent to the inbox. The VIP membership benefits page explains what to compare that message with.

What payment methods are available?

The ACE66 cashier lists current methods. Use the payment checklist to compare names before you send money.

What if the cashier name does not match?

Do not send the transfer. Refresh the cashier and read it again. A chat message with a new account name is a reason to stop.

Do these pages explain how to win?

No. They explain categories, payment names and limits. They do not offer a system, a tip or a promised return.

Can I use a phone?

Yes. A phone browser is enough to get started.

Is there an age limit?

Yes. These products are for adults, 18 and over, and only where they are legal for you. The responsible-play notes say the same thing.

General

Is ACE66 licensed to operate an online casino?

ACE66 is licensed and regulated by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR), under the Offshore Gaming licence and the Electronic Gaming and Poker licence.

Is my personal information secure?

Personal information is protected, and it is not given to a third party unless an applicable law, regulation, or court order requires it.

What is the minimum bet?

It is different for each game, table, or match. The limit is shown on that game.

What happens if the game I bet on has an error?

If a live-casino dealer makes an error, the round is paused while the dealer tells the pit boss. Players are told in the table chat. If it cannot be resolved immediately, the round is cancelled and refunded.

If a sports result was announced incorrectly, the bet is resettled and the game-wallet balance is reconciled to the corrected result.

Unless that game says otherwise, a malfunction voids the pays and the plays.

Return to the homepage

Responsible play

ACE66 Responsible Gaming — Budget, Time Limits & Support

Gambling can cost the money you bring to it. Treat that as the normal case when you plan a session. Entertainment you cannot leave is no longer entertainment.

Limits to Set First

  • You need to be 18 or older.
  • If it is not legal for you, do not open ACE66.
  • Set a time and an amount you can lose. The limit note shows a simple way to write them down.
  • Leave when you hit either line, including when you are ahead.
  • Do not use rent, food money, or borrowed money.
  • Do not send a new transfer to recover the last one.

If you want to talk to someone, use a person you trust or a local health service. These pages do not run a support chat, and they do not publish a phone number.

Back to the homepage

FAQ

What is a turnover requirement that I keep seeing in the terms and conditions?

A turnover for a bonus, also called a rollover or playthrough, is the number of times you must bet your deposit and bonus amount total before you can withdraw any winnings from that bonus and deposit.

What do I have to do to qualify for a bonus?

Different bonuses have different things you need to do to claim them, such as make a deposit, transfer money to a specific wallet, refer to another player and so on.

What does it mean when a bonus is ‘unlimited’?

An unlimited bonus is one where you can enjoy a percentage of your deposit on top of the deposit itself, with no cap on the amount you can enjoy. So the higher your deposit, the more your bonus will be.

What is a bonus validity period?

In online casinos, this usually refers to the period in which you have to fulfill your turnover requirements or risk losing all your winnings from that specific bonus.
